reason: It reads like it was built by someone who knows charter work, and the free migration and money-back offer are fair. But nobody I know has used it. There are no customers at all yet, and I don't put my bookings and accreditation records on software no operator at the association can vouch for.
objection: A brand-new company with zero customers. I'd be the guinea pig, and if it falls over in the middle of school excursion season, or the quoting can't handle real charter jobs with multi-day trips, split pickups and dead running, it's my business that wears it, not theirs.
would_change_my_mind: An operator I know and trust, from the bus association or a nearby depot, has run it for a few months and tells me it handles charter quoting and our accreditation audit properly.
